title: AFOSI agent has crew sign non-disclosure agreement
place_text: Squadron commander's office, Malmstrom Air Force Base

tellings.quote: And by the way, he introduced me to a man from AFOSI, Air Force Office of Special Investigation.

plain: In 1967, in the squadron commander's office at Malmstrom Air Force Base, a missile crew was made to sign a non-disclosure agreement, a promise in writing not to talk about what had happened. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who says he was on that crew, says his commander introduced him to a man from AFOSI, the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, which is the Air Force's own investigative service. Salas tells it as a sign that the Air Force wanted the event kept quiet.
